sources.title: Local Speech to Text for Mac & Windows | EdgeSpeak
sources.snippet: The speech AI model is shaped for desktop execution, reducing wait time while local transcription avoids external service dependencies. Flash / Pro model pairing Flash is tuned for everyday audio and video transcription. Pro targets harder audio, more complex accents, and a higher accuracy ceiling while using more local resources.
